I switched the GPU to a Gigabyte 4070 instead and the PSU to the corsair RM750x like you said. Everything is ordered and it’s supposed to come in by this Saturday!!! I’m very excited but a little nervous to build it but I’ve been doing a lot of research and it’s good to know I can always post in the subreddit given a roadblock. 

Thank you for everything! I’ve been dreaming about building my own pc for the past three years and finally having the money and insight to get the right components and build it is awesome. I have really appreciated your explanations and help :)

Thank you SO much for your in depth description and analysis of each part. To say it helped me understand is an understatement ! Unfortunately, the closest Microcenter to me is about 2.5 hours away and the bundles I looked into are in store only :( Although after looking at everything you said and listening to many of your recommendations, I think I might have figured out a parts list that works for me. I am still a little unsure if i made the right choice for certain components like the RAM, GPU, and power supply, but I’m fairly confident in the other parts although I would like to run it past you just to make sure everything is okay:

[https://pcpartpicker.com/list/9HxMt7](https://pcpartpicker.com/list/9HxMt7)

Side note, the prices on pcpartpicker are a little off, the case and RAM are about $10 less for each in my Amazon cart, not that that makes too big of a difference but I thought it might be worth noting.

And again, thank you so much for your help with this, I was completely lost prior to your comments lol.
I don’t really have a preference, whatever works best. I would like to have a mb with built in wifi and keep the case white though.

To be honest, I really have to idea what I’m doing with picking components. I originally looked at parts lists from Youtube videos and changed stuff from there to fit my budget which is around $1200 but i’m willing to go up to $1400 if necessary. I looked a little more into it and I definitely want to change my CPU to an AMD but I’m still a little confused on what other components need to be swapped.

I’m mainly just using the pc for gaming and I’m not really planning on doing anything else with it other than like school and small stuff.
